name: cortex_review_session
description: End-of-session memory review. Call this when a task or session is complete. It fetches all working memories from the session and returns a decision prompt asking you to evaluate each memory: promote to episodic/semantic, mark obsolete, or leave as working. ALWAYS call this before ending a session to ensure valuable knowledge is preserved.

session_id.description: Session ID to review working memories for

task_summary.description: Optional summary of what was accomplished during the session
